note: The ancestor-root probe runs a real Low-token process through the DSH sandbox runner. The label-removal arm is a CAUSATION control: it proves which layer refuses the read.

skippedRoots.why: contains the execution world: labelling an ancestor of the world refuses the traverse every process needs to start

rootPlan.note: a skipped root is NOT a labelled root; its content is covered only by labels on derived descendants

ancestorException.why: it contains the execution world, and labelling an ancestor of the world refuses the traverse every process needs to start
ancestorException.protectionBasis: the Kernel label on the derived durable root; the sandbox write-grant ACL alone does NOT stop the read

coverageSemantics.noUnprotectedEntryFound: nothing EXAMINED was unprotected — true even for a truncated walk
coverageSemantics.verified: every required entry was examined and nothing examined was unprotected
coverageSemantics.complete: the admission field: no truncation, no enumeration failure, no reparse ambiguity, no unresolved root
